slides.title: Tension builds along Ethiopia's western edge

slides.body: fighters Sudan's army says it plans to mobilise along the Ethiopian border in Gedaref State (Radio Tamazuj, Nov 26). No Ethiopian response was reported.

slides.title: Fighting near Badme
slides.body: EEPA reported federal forces took the Waela Nihbi and Gemhalo areas on Nov 25, then shelled toward Gual Gemhalo. Not independently verified.

slides.title: Western Tigray: fear of no return
slides.body: AFP reports displaced Tigrayans fear they may never go home. Residents it spoke to allege beatings and property theft.

slides.title: Claims not verified
slides.body: AFP did not independently verify the residents' accounts. A senior local official did not respond to its questions.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Allow safe returns.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Radio Tamazuj · EEPA · AFP/Arab News · Nov 26-27, 2026
